name: Sam Demo
bio: Sam has guided the Razorback every summer since 2009 and knows the ridge in every weather. Before Ridgeline, Sam worked ski patrol at Hotham for six winters.
knowsBest: Where the wind hides on the Razorback, and which snow gum gives shelter for lunch.

name: Jo Demo
bio: Jo joined in 2016 after a decade of botanical survey work on the High Plains and is the reason our wildflower walks run when they do.
knowsBest: The exact fortnight the snow daisies peak.
